verdict.rationale: Entrust documents native mobile SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native that collect document captures, plus a hosted Smart Capture Link web journey. Nothing in the pack shows glare, blur or edge detection coaching, and there is no explicitly named web SDK. missing for 10: evidence of glare/blur/edge detection capture coaching, an explicit first-party web SDK, first-try capture quality claims, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try

citations.quote: As a direct replacement to the Onfido Smart Capture SDKs, a new set of mobile SDKs is now available for iOS, Android and React Native
The Smart Capture Link is then sent to your customers, redirecting them towards the interactive steps of a workflow.
